context.goal: 新型电力系统断面潮流控制：兼顾时效性、准确性、泛化性与可解释性，在实时运行和极端天气场景强化断面阻塞决策、确保安全裕度并适应电网动态演化。

previous.Hypothesis_Title: 基于候选筛选召回门限与线性化残差触发交流修正的断面实时阻塞调控假设
previous.Scenario: 面向高比例新能源与交直流并联运行场景的输电断面实时有功阻塞调控：在秒级至分钟级滚动周期内，根据断面有功越限风险与指定N-1支路有功约束，对可调机组、储能及直流功率调制进行候选筛选并生成初始调节动作；测试覆盖正常天气、新能源强波动和极端天气预测误差放大场景，但仅限稳态与指定N-1安全校核，不延伸至动态稳定结论。
previous.Research_Object: 断面实时阻塞调控中的候选有功调节资源池及其交流可执行动作；对象包括送受端可调机组、储能和直流功率调制资源，约束包括断面有功传输限值、支路视在功率/热稳约束、节点电压约束、机组爬坡与调节能力以及指定N-1支路有功安全约束。
previous.Key_Variables: 自变量：候选筛选召回门限ρ（或保留候选比例k）、交流修正触发阈值τ（由预测线性化残差与安全裕度构造）、修正迭代预算B；因变量：交流约束违反率及幅值、断面过载积分、全流程P95时延、调节成本、不可解率与超时回退率、N-1遗漏复核命中数；中介变量：候选维数、修正幅度、修正迭代次数、筛选召回率；控制变量：新能源预测误差水平、负荷水平、N-1故障集合、拓扑状态、机组爬坡能力与通信时延设置。
previous.Method: 构建候选筛选—策略初解—残差触发交流修正—N-1复核—超时回退的仿真流程。候选筛选采用正负综合灵敏度与置信度排序，并以ρ控制保留集合；策略初解可使用已有SAC或规则策略作为被修正对象（不作为创新点）。对初解执行一次AC潮流或局部Jacobian估计，计算断面/支路功率预测残差与安全裕度，若超过τ则启动非凸交流修正（AC OPF或序贯二次/线性搜索），并显式校核支路视在功率、电压和指定N-1；超时则回退到保守再调度。实验采用2×2消融（有无召回门限筛选、有无残差触发修正）加ρ与τ网格扫描，在IEEE 39、IEEE 118及公开参数交直流扩展系统上按运行日与拓扑划分训练/测试，多随机种子和配对场景，比较原始SAC、全候选全修正、双层优化、AC SCOPF基线；记录估计、推理、通信、修正、校核与回退时延分解，报告95%配对自助法置信区间。
previous.Mechanism: 核心机制是：候选筛选通过压缩候选维数降低在线策略与修正求解负担；但筛选会引入遗漏风险，使线性灵敏度近似误差和策略输出误差在AC非线性约束下放大。以预测线性化残差与安全裕度共同构造修正触发阈值，可在残差大或裕度小时才支付交流修正成本，在残差小且裕度足时保持快速初解。ρ与τ的联动改变候选维数、修正幅度和迭代次数，从而在同一计算预算下影响交流约束违反率、断面过载积分、P95时延与调节成本；该协同收益是待检验推论，不是既成结论。
previous.Conditions: 预期改善条件：候选筛选对有效资源召回率足够高；线性化残差与真实AC越限风险正相关；交流修正能在预算内收敛到可行或低违反解；N-1集合与断面限额给定且复核可执行；机组爬坡和调节容量足以覆盖越限；新能源预测误差处于测试覆盖范围。可能不成立条件：筛选门限过高导致有效资源被漏选且修正无法补偿；残差估计失真或拓扑变化使触发阈值失效；非凸交流修正陷入局部解或超时；N-1筛选遗漏关键故障且未复核；通信时延、资源不足或极端天气误差超出训练分布；需要动态稳定/暂态裕度时，本假设的稳态AC修正不能替代动态安全分析。
previous.Prediction: 待检验的定量目标（非已获得结果）：在预注册容差下，相较无残差触发修正的候选筛选方案，交流约束违反率相对下降不低于30%，断面过载积分不增加，全流程P95时延不高于全候选全修正方案的70%；相较无候选筛选方案，候选维数中位数下降不低于50%，且N-1复核遗漏关键故障数不增加。若ρ增大时召回率下降并由修正幅度和迭代次数上升补偿，则可检验中介链条；若P95时延收益被超时回退抵消或交流违反率未改善，则预测失败。
previous.Evidence: 文献事实：E001-p1-c1建立第一层调度节点多目标筛选优化模型，优选参与调整的调度节点；可迁移推论：候选筛选与精确调整可分解，但不能证明该筛选层与SAC修正层具有协同时延收益。文献事实：E001-p1-c2指出仅考虑过载线路与调度节点灵敏度关系可能导致新的线路过载并须多次潮流校验；可迁移推论：候选筛选后需AC安全校核/修正，但未证明联合方案降低违反率。文献事实：E001-p6-c2表明综合灵敏度可能迫使负荷节点切负荷；可迁移推论：筛选存在反向风险，需召回门限与复核。文献事实：E001-p7-c2给出某省级电网09:30断面T1有功调整为3390 MW后越限消除；仅说明单案例时效可行性，不提供P95时延或回退率。文献事实：E082-p0-c2称预定义校正措施可显著减少成本昂贵的预防措施，尤其与潮流控制结合；可迁移推论：校正层与潮流控制互补，但不是SAC断面控制证据。文献事实：E016-p0-c1的safety oracle组合PTDF预筛选、AC Jacobian电压灵敏度预测与line search修正动作；可迁移推论：筛选加AC修正的分层结构可行，但该文为N-2对抗自改进调度，不能证明N-1无遗漏。文献事实：E124-p0-c2称SAC在多数中等预测误差场景可控制支路过载；可迁移推论：SAC可作初解但多数不等于全部，仍需修正与回退。文献事实：E008-p0-c1在4s滚动周期内用PTDF与二次规划协调断面安全、15分钟调度跟踪和新能源消纳；可迁移推论：断面实时控制需要快速筛选与优化，但4s为该文设计，不构成时延保证。文献事实：E050-p0-c2以概率满足N和N-1支路有功安全约束为目标优化移相变压器、再调度与弃电；可迁移推论：N-1约束应显式进入修正层，但概率满足不等于逐场景无遗漏。文献事实：E022-p0-c2显式验证AC潮流可行性和Benders-ADMM收敛；可迁移推论：AC可行性需后验校核，不能仅依赖线性灵敏度或策略输出。文献事实：E027-p0-c2报告动作后条件化使不利事件比例由7.21%降至2.06%；可迁移推论：动作后修正有价值，但不能外推为SAC断面控制收益。以上文献仅支撑分项机制，联合召回门限与残差触发修正在断面场景中的安全与时延收益属于待检验假设。
previous.Innovation: 创新点不是把SAC、GNN等术语组合，而是把候选筛选召回门限ρ与基于线性化残差的修正触发阈值τ作为两个可审计的跨层控制变量，建立“筛选遗漏风险—修正成本—时延”的显式权衡；以残差/安全裕度而非固定迭代预算决定是否支付AC修正，并用召回率与遗漏故障复核作为可解释性审计量。该变量关系和处理方式与仅做比例匹配或置信分层候选的已有构想不同，验证上采用2×2消融加ρ-τ网格扫描和时延分解。
previous.Verification: 采用仿真对照：2×2消融（有/无召回门限筛选、有/无残差触发修正），并扫描ρ与τ；测试IEEE 39、IEEE 118及公开参数交直流扩展系统；按运行日和拓扑划分训练/测试，使用至少5个随机种子和配对场景。对照包括原始SAC、全候选全修正方案、双层优化、AC SCOPF基线；所有方案统一记录估计、推理、通信、修正、校核和回退时延。评价指标：交流约束违反率及幅值、断面过载积分、全流程P95时延、调节成本、不可解率、超时回退率、候选维数、修正幅度/迭代次数、筛选召回率、N-1遗漏复核命中数；用配对自助法给出95%置信区间。失败判据：若相对无修正方案交流违反率未显著下降，或P95时延相对全修正方案未降至预设比例，或超时回退抵消收益，或N-1复核发现筛选遗漏增加且修正不能补偿，则不支持假设；若残差触发与收益无中介相关性，则机制不成立。
previous.Feasibility: 仿真可实施：候选筛选、AC潮流校核、非凸修正和N-1复核均可在现有开源或商业求解器与电力系统仿真环境中完成；数据需求为公开测试系统参数、给定N-1集合和新能源/负荷场景。风险与边界：非凸AC修正不保证全局最优，校正解质量需审计；N-1逐场景校核计算成本高，需离线标签与线上复核边界；状态估计误差、拓扑变化、通信时延和资源不足会削弱外推性；结论仅限稳态与指定N-1集合，不能替代动态稳定分析；需预注册容差并报告负结果，不对安全作绝对保证。

feedback.feedback: 主要优势：假设把候选筛选召回门限ρ与线性化残差触发阈值τ作为可审计的跨层控制变量，显式刻画“筛选遗漏风险—交流修正成本—时延”的权衡；物理边界清晰，限定稳态与指定N-1，不越界作动态稳定结论；验证设计包含2×2消融、ρ-τ网格扫描、多测试系统、配对场景、时延分解和失败判据，可检验性较强。值得优先改进的三点：1）τ的构造与标定仍偏概念化，建议给出可复现公式，明确残差归一化方式、安全裕度度量、与AC Jacobian/PTDF误差或离线分位数的关系，并在独立校准集上预注册τ，检验其与真实AC越限风险的单调性和中介相关性；2）N-1筛选遗漏是核心风险，建议明确N-1候选压缩规则和复核覆盖策略，例如关键故障集合、离线标签、周期性全复核或遗漏上界/重要性采样，并定义“关键故障遗漏”和“修正无法补偿”的判定条件，而不只统计命中数；3）非凸AC修正的局部解与超时回退会直接影响准确性和时延结论，建议设计warm-start、可行性恢复、多起点或保守回退机制，报告不可解率、局部解质量、回退触发频率及端到端P95分解，并在同等硬件和通信预算下与AC SCOPF等强基线比较。

reference_logic.mechanism: 该假设把候选资源筛选与动作交流可行性修正视为两个可分离且互补的环节：正负综合灵敏度用于压缩候选控制资源维数，降低在线优化负担；显式交流非线性修正用于弥补线性灵敏度近似和策略输出误差，使快速决策更接近可执行解。其中介逻辑是：候选维数下降、修正幅度和迭代次数变化，进而在相同计算预算下影响交流约束违反率、断面过载积分、全流程时延和调节成本；其协同收益属于待检验推论，而非既成结论。
reference_logic.evidence_needs: 需要证据分别支持：正负综合灵敏度筛选候选资源的有效性；显式交流安全约束、支路视在功率约束及指定N-1筛选的必要性；交直流稳态联合建模的合理性。还需实证证据检验SAC策略层与修正层是否产生协同收益，包括候选维数、修正幅度、迭代次数等中介变量数据，时延分解数据，不可行与回退事件标签，调节成本容差，以及遗漏故障复核结果。现有文献只能支撑分项机制，不能直接证明联合方案的安全与时延收益。
reference_logic.verification: 可采用2×2消融验证：有无候选筛选、有无交流修正，并在IEEE 39和118节点及参数公开的交直流扩展系统上测试；按运行日和拓扑划分训练测试，使用多个随机种子和配对场景，与原始SAC、不筛选的全维修正方案、双层优化及交流SCOPF基线比较。统一记录估计、推理、通信、修正、校核与回退时延，报告交流约束违反率及幅值、断面过载积分、全流程P95时延、调节成本、不可解率和回退率，并用配对自助法给出95%置信区间。若主要安全或时延比较未改善，或超时回退抵消收益，则不支持协同假设。
reference_logic.gaps: 非凸交流修正不能声称为全局欧氏投影，其局部解质量和收敛性仍需评估；超时或不可行时的应急优化依赖当前状态校验，其有效性和失败计数需单独审计；N-1筛选可能遗漏故障，必须配套复核；结论仅限稳态和指定N-1集合，不能替代动态稳定分析；状态估计误差、拓扑变化、通信时延和资源不足场景会削弱外推性；N-1样本校核成本较高，离线标签生成与线上校核边界需明确；协同收益可能受训练预算、硬件和回退策略影响，需要预注册容差和负结果报告。

context.core_mechanism_constraint: 假设候选维数压缩可减少在线求解负担，交流修正可消除线性灵敏度和策略近似误差；二者互补，使相同计算预算下的快速决策更接近可执行解。通过候选维数、修正幅度和迭代次数检验这一中介链条。

Communications costs can be computed in terms of transfer time, deﬁned as the end–to–end total delay, i.e., the time from the moment a sender puts data content on top of its transmission stack up to the moment the receiver extracts the data from its received stack [42]. Two main contributions to the transfer time are the transmission delay (encompassing waiting time) and the propagation delay. While the former captures the time between signal generation and its arrival at the receiver, the latter represents the time it takes for feedbacks to travel from the sender to the receiver over the physical medium. Under normal operating conditions, the propagation delay may be neglected; transfer times reduce then to transmission delays. hits.file: Non-solution power flow diagnosis method for AC/DC hybrid power grid based on topology-aware graph neural network
hits.text: With the continuous evolution of power grids, the issue of power flow unsolvability in hybrid AC–DC grids, arising from topological changes, abrupt load variations, or control failures, has become increasingly prominent. To overcome the black-box nature inherent in conventional artificial intelligence methods, this work explicitly models identifiable manifestations of physical constraints through interpretable graph neural network (GNN) layers. Consequently, this paper develops a data-driven and physics-model-fused diagnostic approach: the topology-aware graph neural network (TAGNN). A dual diagnostic strategy based on DC-side harmonic injection and AC-side voltage sensitivity is proposed. This establishes explicit mappings between topological characteristics and power flow feasible regions, thereby revealing the intrinsic relationship between grid topological structures and unsolvable power flow conditions. hits.file: Optimised Congestion Management Using Curative Measures in Combined AC/DC Systems with Flexible AC Transmission Systems
hits.text: implementation of optimised congestion management in an A Mathematical Programming Language (AMPL)-based nonlinear optimisation problem. AMPL is an effective tool to deal with highly complex problems of optimisation and scheduling. Therefore, the modelling of assets and flexibilities for power flow control in AC/DC systems in combination with an innovative grid operation strategy using predefined curative measures for the optimised use of the existing grid is introduced. The nonlinear mathematical optimisation aims at the optimal cost selection of flexibility measures. The application of the optimisation technique in a combined AC/DC system shows the optimal preventive and curative use of measures in operational congestion management. Simulation results prove that, by using predefined curative measures, the volume of cost-intensive preventive measures can significantly be reduced, especially in association with power flow control.

hits.file: Congestion management through rotor stress controlled optimal transmission switching
hits.text: Security constrained optimal transmission switching (SC‐OTS) can be an essential part of future smart grids with flexible topologies. Transmission switching, however, can have adverse impact on generators because of creating excessive torque on their rotor shafts. In this study, SC‐OTS as an effective tool is applied to relieve congestion while considering AC constraints and generator rotor shaft impact caused by switching. As opposed to previously used simplified models based on standing phase angle, this study utilises dynamic response of generators to accurately calculate the actual stresses on rotors because of switching. In addition, network N ‐1 security criterion is taken into account. In the proposed model, OTS actions are obtained through a bi‐level process. In the upper level, OTS set is determined and the applicability of each action is checked in the lower level. hits.file: Optimised curtailment of distributed generators for the provision of congestion management services considering discrete controllability
hits.text: Grid operation becomes a more challenging task due to the increasing amount of distributed generators in the system. Consequently, critical situations with violations of operational limits occur more frequently. Hence, grid operators have to take corrective countermeasures to ensure the security of supply. This study presents a discrete optimisation approach to determine the optimal amount of distributed generator curtailment regarding multiple objectives. The proposed method is based on non‐linear AC load flow analysis of the network. The method is implemented into a modified version of the IEEE 14‐bus test system and the necessary amount of generation curtailment to retain predefined operational limits is identified. Simulations are carried out for different contingency scenarios and several possible increments of curtailment levels are compared. Results reveal the potential to reduce the total amount of power adjustments distinctly by using curtailment levels with smaller step sizes

hits.file: Probabilistic Security-Constrained Preventive Control under Forecast Uncertainties Including Volt/Var Constraints
hits.text: The continuous increase in generation from renewable energy sources, marked by correlated forecast uncertainties, requires specific methodologies to support power system operators in security management. This paper proposes a probabilistic preventive control to ensure N-1 security in presence of correlated uncertainties of renewable sources and loads. By adopting a decoupled linear formulation of the AC load flow equations, the preventive control is decomposed into two subsequent linear programming problems, the former concerning the active power and the latter the voltage/reactive power-related issues. In particular, in the active control problem, the algorithm combines Third Order Polynomial Normal Transformation, Point Estimate Method, and Cornish–Fisher expansion to model the forecast uncertainties and characterize the chance constraints in the problem. hits.file: Resilient Event-Triggered Distributed Economic Dispatch Control Strategy Under DoS Attacks
hits.text: Distributed economic dispatch in AC distribution systems relies heavily on communication networks and is therefore vulnerable to denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. To address this issue, this paper proposes a resilient event-triggered distributed economic dispatch control strategy. Two typical DoS attack scenarios, namely communication-link blocking and node isolation, are first modeled, and an event-triggered distributed economic dispatch controller is then developed to maintain incremental cost consensus and system power balance while reducing communication overhead. Based on Lyapunov stability theory and a linear matrix inequality approach, sufficient conditions for the asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system are derived, tolerable bounds on the frequency and duration of DoS attacks are established, and the absence of Zeno behavior is proved.
